decision: 5 Second time penalty (1 penalty points imposed, total of 3 points in the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 12 September 2021 Time 15:48 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Left the track and Re-joined the track in an unsafe manner at turn 4/5
offence: Breach 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The driver locked his brakes entering Turn 4 and cut behind the apex of the corner. When re-joining he moved fully across to the left making contact with Car 55. The Stewards considered this re-joining unsafely.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 99 Re Joining The Track In An Unsafe Manner
